Mutant #112.reason: Equivalent for every flow the script builds: < and <= differ only at gamma == 1e-15. make_flow fixes 1/beta = 1.001953125. A positive gamma near zero is 1/beta - c with c in [1, 2), which Sterbenz makes exact, so gamma is a multiple of 2**-52 in FP64 (2**-23 in FP32). 1e-15 is 4.5036 * 2**-52, so it is never reached. The adjacent window [1e-15, 2e-15) is reachable and its 2e-15 mutant is killed by test_inspection_keeps_a_positive_stabilizer_just_above_the_reset_threshold.
